title: Refactor xtask into modules

in: Split xtask implementation into modules with clap CLI structs/enums centralized and each cbd subcommand handler in its own file.
Move shared helpers into util modules as applicable (paths, fs, json, template, prompt, process, git).
Keep the public CLI and behavior unchanged (command names, arguments, exit codes, verification logic).
Keep output formats, templates, and generated file contents unchanged.
out: Add new CLI flags or subcommands.
Change exit codes, error handling semantics, or verification logic.
Change JSON schema or template formats or generated outputs.

definition_of_done: each clause id in pre/post/invariants/errors has a proof entry in evidence.json
Rust enforcement is authoritative; TypeScript enforcement is UX-only
